notes.title: Summer Patch 0.5.4
notes.content:
Start
This update adds a new location Tower of Infinity, a new character Ghost and Wraith.

Since version 0.5, I have the impression that every approach is the lucky one and defeating the final boss with one hit is no longer fun. All the changes in this version change the numbers so that achieving a ‘lucky run’ is something SKILLFULL.


Seasonal bar look
During the hot weather, you can cool off in the bar with real summer decorations.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/a49cd011fd94ea7e4b21c78829a355f218d919f3.png"]
New location - Infinite Tower
There is a special fight waiting in the tower - BOSSRUSH. There you fight each boss one by one. Each boss gets a boost to maximum health, damage dealt, projectile speed and movement speed.

To enter this level, beforehand you must find the key of the moon which is awarded for various challenges such as defeating the rat king.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/ffa11855c220597dca450fb9296ec078f5c91fcb.png"]
New character - Ghost and Wraith
The Ghost and the Wraith change in battle. Ghost deals a lot of damage to opponents but is slow and gets some of the damage itself. Wraith is fast and heals on her attacks, but has a huge downside to the damage she deals.

To unlock them you must first get to and defeat the enemies in the Infinite Tower.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/810e3f82aa9f7775c88e3b13683cff7daf057824.png"]General changes
Changed the way to end dash if you are flying towards the enemy

Anvil with gloomy effects: ‘Cursed’ and ‘Abyss’ modifiers removed, ‘Reaper’ and ‘Backstab’ modifiers added

Corrected the text of many weapon modifiers and the weapons themselves, it is more readable and fewer errors

Bosses in the Magic Forest and the final boss have more health

Weapon cooldown speed scales with attack speed just like the rest of the animations


Changes to weapon modifiers
Many modifiers got new descriptions to make everything elegantly consistent. Many effects now have changed numbers

All-seeing - Increased slowdown, reduced damage reduction, fixed bug through which it activated too often

Boom Boom Hammer -  Damage infliction added, description changed (even though the description said damage, the effect did not inflict damage)

Poison (weak) - reduced damage

Abyss - base damage scaling was reduced and healing was reduced (the effect was too powerful and too easy to use)

Air - description changed

Ancient - the armor granted has been reduced, more enemies grant armor after defeat (previously it depended on the health of the enemy, now the enemies are divided into categories: small, medium, large. The effect does not work with small opponents)

Backstab - reduced base damage, reduced scaling with player damage, added scaling with weapon damage (damage dealt will be more intuitive for the weapon held)

Bleed - scaling with enemy health has been reduced

Bomb - Base damage reduced, scaling with player damage increased

Brutal - reduced crit chance

Candle - Increases buff to weapon damage, decreases buff to weapon range

Cursed - curse check takes kisses into account, damage awarded has been reduced (this weapon is very weak at the beginning of the game but if you play with 10 kisses it is the most powerful weapon in the game)

Druid - decreased base damage, decreased damage with each buff (the effect was too powerful, the druid gets extra range so it doesn't need a huge increase in damage)

Eclipse - reduced the chances of creating the effect, increased the base damage (the effect is now more effective with good luck, previously it activated too often and did too little)

Fire - decreased base damage and number of ticks, increased scaling with elemental mastery (All elemental modifiers were very strong even without mastery this change will separate them from other effects)

Flow - Base damage reduced, scaling with damage increased

Ghost Portal - the number of hits needed to summon a ghost has been reduced, ghosts do not scale with elemental mastery (ghosts in version 1.0 will be even better)

Ice - reduced the base damage of the effect and explosion and reduced the number of hits (the effect was too strong)

Ignite - Base damage and number of strikes reduced, time between strikes reduced

Jester - reduced the granted stats for enemies, the chance of boosting an enemy decreases depending on luck (scales better with luck and doesn't penalize the player for just existing)

Lightning Chain - base damage reduced, scaling with mastery increased, new effect added: hit enemies receive more damage from all sources by 10% (effect does not disappear and is cumulative)

Melody - the chance of a critical hit has been reduced

Paladin - the granted armor has been increased

Poison - the number of strikes has been reduced and the time between strikes has been increased

Puddle - From now on, it deals elemental damage and does not scale with player damage

Ritual - greater chance of summoning a bat

Spider - is now labeled as a summon rather than an damage type

Stone - reduced base damage, added scaling with mastery (overall this is a weakening, the effect inflicted massive damage)

Fission - reduced the damage increment for each stack (it was reaching sick damage too fast)

Wind - weapon knockback reduced

Wood - damage bonus reduced from 50% to 30%


Next update
The next version of the game will already be 1.0 developmentally called “lore update” and it will be a full release of the game.

Keep in mind that the game in version 1.0 will undergo a big final makeover so expect lots of news! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Ghost and Wraith join the bar!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/810e3f82aa9f7775c88e3b13683cff7daf057824.png"]New place = new character
To play Ghost and Wraith you must first rescue them from the Infinite Tower. Together, they don't care about health and use contacts from the afterlife to their advantage.


It will be possible to play with them in 2days !!! (26.06.2025)


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/f5a230ff1994bc2d6e45ba416a35a09e0056c0bd.png"]
Active Skill - Change of Form
Change form from Ghost to Wraith and vice versa. Each change summons ghosts that attack enemies. The number of ghosts depends on the player's level. Both forms share stats and health points


Ghost
He has reduced movement speed and attack speed, and deals much more damage from all sources. Each hit on the enemy takes away the ghost's health. When he loses health he has a small chance to summon a ghost.


Wraith
She has an increased attack range, reduced dash cooldown time and is faster than a Ghost. She has a huge penalty to the damage dealt, most often a hit will not damage the opponent. Each hit renews health.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/e12268127746b87372555bbdee3eba5111462059.png"]\ Trying to capture the GHOST on camera (that white smoke should be it) \



During combat, you need to intentionally control your health level, you can play aggressively and keep your health low on purpose to activate an effect such as Rage, or play it safe on an almost full health bar but deal very little damage.

All the effect of receiving damage and healing are extremely effective.



In addition, ghosts are regularly summoned to help (ghosts will get more support in version 1.0).

notes.title: Version 0.5 - “BossRush” NOW AVAILABLE
notes.content:
New bosses
Each main floor will feature 2 new bosses. There are some that fight in close combat, others that turn the room into an bullet hell and others that change their style depending on the player's decision! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/533be8b52b1a726b9bf50fb7e78db2c9a44f4127.png

Changing the lighting system
Now everything in the game reacts better to light. Characters and enemies are now more strongly exposed by all light sources and cast a shadow on their own model. All light sources have uniform power which allows to add light to bright scenes such as the Flying Machine.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/28f4c9f073f3dc36a2ba50d2ea6c3d891dee0790.png

Collections
From now on, everything that is discovered in the game will be added to the COLLECTIONS menu in which you can read about the effect and about the lore. in 0.5.0, seven categories will be active: Moveset, Characters, Weapon Modifiers, Perks, Weapon Packs, Drinks, Stages. In the future, the category of Enemies will be added.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/f1da2c63557a47f0c364e0c11f310234cf675797.png Yes I know, there are no eyes but for that there is no description either 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/52e6348e7090ccc72ecb7e6990297423027905b9.png It is possible that more details will be added later 

Character level
Now defeating enemies adds experience points. Instead of creating a random boost after each battle from now on, the player for each level can choose 1 of 3 random stats. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/8592ab46a198132c672b2f3f9ed34429173d5d48.png

Main stages
All main floors now have twice as many available rooms to generate, new enemies and more details!

[expand type=details expanded=false]
Forbidden library
The library from now on also has a less castle and more library theme. The new rooms may feature a group of jesters, these are enemies whose attacks are extremely random.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/e23ae054fcdd89aa7e6fd11c4c9b8ed62c484969.png

Flying machine
New rooms in steel version in which opponents are powerful but also very slow.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/75aed083af1de1efa742585515c669b02cb05899.png

Magical forest
New islands that were taken over after the Viking invasion. The magic forest will receive a lot of new enemies and in general the whole level will be much bigger.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/27f52d9ebe1f58dbaf5843a2789f7d7cd1d9bd7a.png
[/expand]

New attack system
The game no longer has heavy attacks that you have to hold, instead there is a new Special Attack. Each weapon type has a unique heavy and special attack. From now on, more attacks toss enemies into the air. Some examples below:
[expand type=details expanded=false]
Katana

Normal attack: a sequence of 5 hits.
Heavy attack: Automatically dash forward and slash dealing minor damage.
Special attack: Charge a zone that deals damage to everyone in range. Effect scales with the number of weak and strong strikes in the combo
Follow-up attack: a series of 3 weak strikes

Heavy Sword

Normal attack: a sequence of 3 strikes.
Heavy attack: sequence of 3 strikes, each strike can toss the enemy into the air
Special attack: drop to the ground, deal large area damage
Continuation attack: use special attack.

[/expand] All information about each weapon attack is available in the COLLECTIONS menu in the main menu of the game 

Characters
Each character got changes, mainly scaling with level was added, many characters got new effects.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/99ef1de0c9587857ccf5653a535010e6abd04dbb.png

[expand type=details expanded=false]
Villager

For each level, he gets 5 maximum health.
Healing sandwich scales with character level

Thief

[Active]Picklock - can use a picklock to open anything that requires a key, to succeed you need to pass a minigame
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/499e198951c1479365ba78d0bd131a9c730dea84.png

Wolf

UI and special effects revamped

Ninja

Every 3rd dash creates a clone that throws shurikens at opponents

Joker

New starting weapon BonkBonk hammer.
Can draw different stats per level
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/3cfca14bc58d1c56b57649f78a04c0629fc9eccd.png

Gladiator

When the shield is destroyed, lightning strikes all enemies in the area
[Active] Electric blast - after destroying the shield, it can once create a wave of electricity that deals elemental damage
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/13f97cd18cc823958cf61072061e4ef7059f5383.png

Pirate

New starting weapon Shovel.
If he runs for a long time he summons a boat which seriously increases movement speed
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/33aced259ed19638e200947b61da6fca5838761f.png

Vampire

It has an alternative dash that flies upwards
Zombie mode - once per attempt if he loses all health instead of defeat he enters a special mode, if he defeats the enemy during the mode he survives
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/47d640a3fc4b9dfba9291c21c595c3d18fdf1dd1.png

Knight

If the parry succeeds it has 1 second cooldown time
He can make a perfect parry, for a perfect parry the chance of getting a chest in the room increases

Monk

After using the grappling hook on the terrain, his movement speed is increased.

Hobo

The thrown potion creates a positive effect if it doesn't hit anyone, or a negative effect if it hits an enemy.
After drinking 4 potions, he loses consciousness and the random battle room is automatically cleared

Viking

New starting weapon axe
Both starting axes have a weapon modifier
Rage gain scales with maximum level

Mage

First he must choose the spell he wants to use, the spell cannot be used again until he has used several others
A new element - water, uses the weapon modifier of the puddle, a new spell rain - increases the damage received to everyone in range
Per level, he improves his spells not stats
Spells can evolve if upgraded 5+ times
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/c4d0ea98a066065c2a2e28504d93b960197c121f.png

Maid

[Active]Apple of Love - Once per floor, she can charm a selected opponent and turn him into her sidekick.
Sidekicks appear in battle, attack opponents and can get projectile damage
If the sidekick survives the fight there is a small chance that he will give a small amount of gold
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/1192d6539aea3beea778fb1ece5d074edf62a937.png

Huntress

All animations have been improved.

Robot

The robot skill now gives a level
The robot has an alternative window from the levelup
[Perk] Drawing machine - every 15 seconds draws a buff or debuff with a small chance of a jackpot
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/fd846475aeb43d271cd91bab49da56f6c8bcfa80.png

Bard

From now on, it activates notes not on attack but on skills.
Each skill adds one of 4 weapon effects: Leaf, Poison, Wood, Druid
Each note still adds a buff that resets when the effect is activated

Fairy

Alternative dash that flies upward
New starting weapon dagger with modifier for knockback

Devil

All stores are changed to special demonic stores in which you can buy perks and weapons only from weapon packs
New starting weapon - scythe.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/66ce8fb3c3920795a9fa5aec39ee0684878630dc.png

Witch

The appearance of the potion creation screen has been changed.
Raised potions now give random ingredients of different colors instead of one color
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/c02d430fcf87a1222c92583d8a3793ed65de451a.png

Cowboy

Skills change after use and not on a combo basis as before

[/expand]

Anvils.
The anvils previously were too powerful, so they've rebuilt how they work.

The anvil destroys after 1 use.
All anvils in the game are slightly cheaper.
Now the anvil displays a choice of 1 of 2 weapon modifiers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/a6231a8e811800d261bab345549b8c1d878c6409.png

UI.

The size of the health bar depends on the player's maximum health.
Refreshed the appearance of information windows for checked potions, weapons, perks
Refreshed and added animation to the inventory window [TAB].
Changed the appearance and added animation to the window from selecting perks
Changed the appearance of the pause window
Added weapon knockback stat to all weapon stats windows
.

Other.

New potion that adds 20 experience points
You can skip dialogue scrolling by clicking Interactions (F) 
On the train, the number of chests has been reduced from 6 >> 3 but a shopkeeper who sells perks related to potions and gold has been added
.

https://www.tiktok.com/@dummydungeongame

Collections
A place where you can check out all the moves, effects, characters and floors. Mainly you will be able to check the lore and models of individual things. 
There is still one important category missing from this screen, that is, the ENEMIES. This category will be created later after the release of the update because there are a lot of things to add there....
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/20961e2065acaea0383fa72b7cd6372b495191d9.png

Enemies
As I write this the six new bosses are already up and running and waiting for final polishing and balancing. As it gets closer to the update's release you can expect lots of clips of the fights

Despite the fact that the update is literally called 'BossRush' the largest part of it adds regular opponents but I won't spoil that now.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/d6a57ca6ebef47481d8f50bdca4bdfe908855763.png
 Cube master - himself does not have lethal attacks, instead he controls cubes that can crush a player, he often teleports around his square arena 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/4616fb3761a680053fbad18984a38d70d6767e4d.png
 The old boxer model - shortens the distance to the player as much as he can, has very precise attacks that you have to move away from, in the second phase he releases his energy and leaves electric fields dealing continuous damage 

Special attacks
I remove from the game attacks that need to be held down. In their place comes a new type of attack - Special Attack. Every weapon in the game now has attacks: Weak, Heavy, Special, Follow-up 
Several types of weapons work completely differently, for example: 
- Fists no longer have a limitation on weak attacks
- Heavy sword has a huge area range on a special attack and on ground slam
- Spear can take the player into the air on a heavy attack, the special attack is this charged dash

 In the COLLECTION you can see how each move type works for each weapon type, they are all recorded and displayed in the game however Steam doesn't support .mp4 so for now you will have to take my word for it 

New stage styles
Each main floor will get rooms in a new theme. By how I create the rooms the number of variations is limited. Thanks to the new styles, each level will be less monotonous. In addition, depending on the style of the rooms there will be different enemies!

notes.title: Devlog #4 - Next big update
notes.content:
The next update will change pretty much everything in the game. ːsteamhappyː Itʼs all about making Dummy Dungeon, when fully released, the best game possible! (the update after 0.5 will be a 1.0 update)
Many of the things I'm showing now are in the middle of getting polished and may look different on the update release.

Graphics rework
The rendering of light and shadows will be changed. Now all objects leave a shadow. Bright levels can have strong lighting that doesn't look like a supernova explosion.... ːsteamfacepalmː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/e6d22f0167401b0aad45ac9350bb576e455dd0bf.png

Level and experience
Instead of white perk orbs, now the player gets experience points! For a new level, you can choose one of 3 possible stats. This way, fighting on alternative floors and arena battles have a new purpose - to collect experience points!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/886db983eaf5fcc95f62487149a55467510ab41e.png

Character changes
With the addition of levels, the skills of many characters can be much more powerful in the late game. That is why many characters will get new passive and active skills. Several characters will be completely revamped to better represent their play style.

Mage

Mage now can choose what spells he casts
For a level, he improves the stats of his spells
Spells that are upgraded many times evolve

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/ed2fca6c82127223a4a9fe84e9b5137d9d0530cc.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/bdc006521b4974593d92e78021529ba733223d09.png

Vampire

Alternative dash that flies upward
Once per run instead of losing the vampire enters zombie mode, if he defeats someone in this mode he survives

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/c73228562bf2708b0fbd1d9b01e673cc7ab222a9.png

Anvils
Anvils are cheaper and are destroyed after one use. For that, it now creates a choice of 1 of 2 possible modifiers. This change will weaken the power of anvils which were highly exaggerated and additionally introduce cool decision-making.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/2f158cef41c77c4373cf2af42ec68c2b9a2f5be7.png

UI look
Many UI elements will have animations and a refreshed look!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/e9c4d2a66370e90121cc34167b31fcd49da27c1d.png

New bosses and a new ending approach will be shown in the next devlog! (best at the end)

notes.title: Early Access Roadmap Part 2
notes.content:
Introduction
The previous Roadmap ended with version 0.3.0, so I wrote up a new one. Honestly, there are few aspects of the game left that need to be reworked which is why I planned to release the full version of the game after 0.4.
I don't mention mini patches to fix bugs and improve balance, because of course they will be coming all the time.

Anything yet to happen in the unplanned version

 Steamcloud - I need to test this and cloud saving will be available in 0.3
 Challenges - achievements - New achievements unrelated to progression. They would focus on less common game mechanics or specific character usage e.g. 'As a Monk, defeat everyone in the room without using a weak or strong attack'.


Bosses Update
Will improve all bosses and especially the final fight and the 2nd floor boss. Before the final fight, there will be a new floor, a final store and the fight will be completely rebuilt. The general changes will be as follows:

 Bosses will not be knockbacked when their toughness bar is charged, instead they will be stunned.
 Most bosses will be able to be tossed into the air.
 The health bar of a boss will take into account the toughness of the boss.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/a111c77cd51b30f912cf73a95909a1e243b920cf.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/dd1b645b682be04e42efcd0fe476d8a9d6312f59.pngAn early look of the new location before the final boss

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/0a2a34358f9db2f27fd743a24950e65bd0e6e012.pngMostly finished Last Shop(floor between 3rd floor Magic Forest and 4th Final Fight)

Endgame update
All content with permanent mechanics is housed in one location which unlocks after finishing run second time. There, you can unlock weapon packs (weapon sets that are added to the item pool in chests and stores), dungeon events (there are currently: Vampire Challenge, Colosseum, Hunt), and character drinks (after beating the game, you can unlock a drink that gives you a small boost at the beginning of the game). In a nutshell, the interface will be improved, the placement of npcs and the floor design will be slightly changed. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/21d6c4f37b5b4395c331d82f07529b86d1cb56f3.png

Version 0.4.0 - Boss Rush
This version will add new enemies, new fight rooms and most importantly new bosses.

New Opponents
Unique enemies in roguelike can never be too much, new enemies and rooms with fights will increase the number of possibilities which is very important for procedurally generated dungeons.
New opponents will appear on all main floors and several new uprisings for side floors
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/8c46b8d0421f3cba179ab57f4066f658e23a958a.png
early models of the mine opponent and first floor opponent

New Bosses
All new bosses will not have any powerful gimmicks. They will mainly rely on attack animations. Fights against the new bosses will not have big breaks in damage capability.

Here are some developer descriptions on sample bosses:.
1st floor - Guardian of Light - Boss with a lantern on a long rope which he throws against the ground (all attacks focus on this), on the second phase projectiles fall out of the lantern, very low mobility, the rope also beats damage

2nd floor - Discobot - which lights up the floor under the player or in a random pattern, will itself have simple laser attacks every so often at the player

Boss Rush - Alternative run ending
You will be able to choose to fight the final boss or a new run ending that will also save the princess. Boss rush will work like an arena but instead of regular enemies, Bosses from different floors will be created. Boss stats will be minimally changed.

Version 1.0.0
Coming out of Early Access. This version will be similar to the 0.2 Warm-up Patch and will add a little bit of everything without much context. The most important new feature will be the final scene after rescuing all the princesses.

 New weapon type (we are considering between: rapier, two swords, double blade).
 New perks - as in 0.2 will develop several different styles of play and will be of different rarity
 Final scene - the last scene after rescuing all the princesses and the official end of the game with end credits.

notes.title: Devlog #3 - The future of version 0.2
notes.content:
Start
The entire 0.2 version focuses on improving elements of the game that are very poor in quality. The previous huge Perks Update added missing features to the perk system and changed the least intuitive ones. Future updates will be similar in size and improve the clarity of the game.
Everything shown here is of course under development, the final version may differ from now.

Interface update 0.2.5
There are a huge number of boosts/passive abilities in the game that currently display under the health bar, but you can't check what they do. It's the same with character abilities, it displays that it's ready to use, you don't know what's going to happen. This update will focus on the UI and more specifically on adding descriptions where we can.

From this update, all icons on the TAB(inventory) will have descriptions that will show when you hover the mouse. 

Characters will have a revised details window describing in more detail all passive and active skills.

Through the UI update, some characters will get changes to make the game easier, e.g. the robot skill “scrap weapons” will be used as a separate skill on E(skill) instead of working on holding F(interaction).

Dungeon events update 
This will be a small update to make it easier to unlock characters and add new variants to existing challenges, e.g. The monk challenge will be completely revamped.

There is nothing to add here, a small update that makes it easier to unlock some characters.

Combat update
Changes in opponents and bosses on each floor. Several (2-3) new opponents will be added. The 2nd floor boss and opponents on the 3rd floor will get huge changes. 

The biggest change will get the final boss of the game for which there will be a new floor (between the 3rd floor and the final fight) and a completely revamped 2nd and 3rd phase of the fight.

notes.title: The month of the sword behind us....
notes.content:
Introduction
Throughout September, every day I created and showed (on Twitter) a new weapon based on a previously prepared keyword. Here I would like to show some of the cool effects I created during this time!

This sword belongs to...
The words this year represented the owner of the weapon. I won't hide the fact that I had a lot of trouble with names that are already in the game e.g. The Witch is in the game and has a weapon so coming up with another weapon with a similar effect for her was quite a challenge. In the end, thanks to this challenge, the pool of interesting items in the game has increased significantly, making each approach even more interesting!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/44fd0baed81b8f3557744042deaba9e1d56b41c3.png

In-game action
Here are what weapons were created during this time:

 5 daggers
 9 heavy swords
 1 spear
 11 swords
 4 katanas
 1 axe

Day 5: Spymaster
An axe that causes invisibility if the player starts charging a strong attack. A weapon ideal for dealing massive damage in one hit and very good for stealing items from the store.
[previewyoutube=VvT5NboqeJg;full][/previewyoutube]

Day 11: Queen
The second weapon that is not a sword, the Queen's spear. It generates gold every 5 strikes. A very powerful effect that will definitely not collapse the economy in the game!
[previewyoutube=Z3W04YFcNfY;full][/previewyoutube]

Day 18: Bard
A heavy sword with a very simple effect, the last attack in the combination of blows is enhanced.
[previewyoutube=uEmMTGxdSiY;full][/previewyoutube]

Day 21: Mermaid
A katana that has powerful pushback, but only if the player is in the middle of a bunnyhop.
This weapon has powerful damage only on opponents without repulsion reduction.
[previewyoutube=Wa3ulq0Yic0;full][/previewyoutube]

Summary
Of course, there are many more weapons that I could show here, but I prefer to leave it for you to discover because the Early Access of the game is approaching fast. I still plan to publish some Steam devlogs before the release and if you want to follow the progress of the production in real time, feel free to twitter!

notes.title: Devlog #1 - Magical Forest
notes.content:
Introduction
Magic forest which is theoretically the most difficult floor in the whole game. The forest where the eternal battle between magical creatures and barbarians takes place

Opponents
Unlike the previous floors, some of the opponents of the forest have a human form and therefore think a little harder and are able to use magical flowers to move, are able to mate when fighting the player, of course they also have emotions and some can give up!

For example, Druid Healer - stays out of combat and strengthens allies from afar. If there is no longer anyone to strengthen then she gives up and does not continue fighting.

[previewyoutube=EDZ3tn8aigE;full][/previewyoutube]
Besides humans, the second largest population is the slime! Only they are not the usual slimy green slime, each represents a different element and behaves differently fire slime likes to explode itself, electric create several smaller slime, and stone hardens and tries to ram the player

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/78a223f88f85f636b517e5d0cbef9b658c6c2a82.gif

The last group in the magic forest are the barbarians - they have simple but extremely powerful attacks. Their special ability is that each can strengthen all other opponents (increase health and damage inflicted)

I won't mention the final opponent of this floor, it will be a surprise!

Magical plants
Under the influence of magic, the land in the forest area began to give birth to very suspicious plants,
Which can be used during combat to your advantage.
Currently, 3 different plants can be found in the game:

 Exploding tuber - when hit, it explodes. 
 Natural trampoline - bounces in a defined direction.
 Soul bells - explodes, does not deal damage but causes temporary invisibility


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/eab02a878059a78ef0e75d934f646a776d678287.png

Special Rooms
Jester time challenge
For passing the challenge, the player gets a random rare ability, you just need to enter the room before a few minutes (in the game it will be a specified number, and knowing me I will change it 4 more times)

Challenging a monk
After defeating the arena in a certain room, a portal to the monk's endurance challenge will open.
The challenge will require the player to quickly pass the duel and terrain obstacles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/3f0f2eda101c88688eb46b305834bef3db7537d2.png

What's next
As something, the project is doing well and is developed so actually every day. I'd like to share the progress with you so I'm going to start running more such Devlogs here on Steam. In the Devlogs I will show what I am currently working on, so everything you see here can only get better!

notes.title: Demo Dummy Dungeon
notes.content:
What will the game demo include?

 4 playable characters - each with a unique playstyle
 14 different perks
 12 weapons (+4 starting character weapons)
 First floor with a boss fight and optional tutorial


Characters
Hobo
Throwing and drinking potions.
Once per room cast a potion that can: create a positive aura, buff, weaken an enemy or explode, the farther the thrown potion flies, the better it works!
Drinking the potion takes away his health and give a permanent random stat

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/e8b3f2df01e8ec71b5aea2a138f9097193decb83.png

Ninja
Deals a lot of damage with dash and skill.
For each enemy you defeat, you receive a shuriken up to three(3) maximum, enemies hit with a shuriken receive 50% more damage from all sources of damage.
Dash also deals damage and has a very low cooldown.
Despite its high damage, it is one of the most difficult character in the demo (due to his very low health and his overall difficulty).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/b637481a72ece2e9ee253d9368366fe98cdc9a58.png

Gladiator
Taking advantage of poor health.
The less health he has, the more damage he deals.
He has a shield that can absorb damage but is not indestructible. 
When destroyed, it must renew itself but the gladiator gets a boost to attack speed for a few seconds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/9bdcc1f8ab027e4f1df1a3197f87707aedef01a6.png

Villager
Balanced gameplay and great luck.
Every 3 rooms he can eat a sandwich and regain some health!
So called class, what more can be said about him.... He is a well balanced character with great luck. A very solid character for any playstyle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/dee3a1901e45963d239d4ddb28751702b27ae31e.png

Special Rooms
The bard's challenge
A bard needs help tuning his instrument. Go down to the altar and start the duel.
This is one of the more difficult challenges in this version of the game. In the full version of the game after passing the challenge the bard joins the cast of playable characters, but in this version this is disabled.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/cb2322dd4d35e598468b63788015bfbcdc8e63af.png

Miscellaneous store
Weapons and potions are available for purchase in the store. In this version of the game, the pool of items is heavily reduced to meet all available weapons and potions within a few approaches.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/61266b2711bdb4a091619402e71d1d29bdd6af14.png

Treasure room
There is no combat in this room, there are free chests and a suspicious-looking flap to the underworld.
In the demo the flap cannot be opened, in the full version of the game it leads to one of three alternative floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984484/6bfe93c6489580f4dfebd57af2e82140c9bdacce.png

Summary
The demo will be available for the duration of the festival and later disabled!
About perks and weapons I will not elaborate because there are simply too many of them. If what you see here arouses your curiosity try out our demo and see for yourself how it all plays out!
A lot of things are being changed and the game is looking better and better every week, but playing the demo will be the perfect opportunity to check out the fundamental gameplay. 

See you in the dungeon ːujelː
